function_v0.doc:
Open (or add to) a leveraged position: `deposit` of the user's own
`collateral` plus `borrow` of `debt` swapped (by `swap`, made by the receiver)
into at least `min_out` more collateral, all supplied as collateral in `pool`.
Returns the finished health factor (7 decimals). `approve_expiry` is the ledger the
pool's allowance lapses at, fixed when the transaction is signed.
function_v0.name: open

cases.doc: The pool returned without running the staged swap (not a Blend pool).
cases.name: NotExecuted

cases.doc: close with nothing to withdraw (no collateral of that asset in the pool).
cases.name: NoPosition

function_v0.doc:
Close (all or part of) a leveraged position: flash-borrow `flash_amount` of `collateral`,
swap it (by `swap`) into at least `min_out` of `debt` for the user, repay `repay` of
`debt` (an amount above the debt repays it all; Blend refunds the rest), withdraw
`withdraw` of collateral (`None`: all of it), and repay the flash loan from it.
Returns the remaining health factor, or 0 when no debt is left. With debt left it must
be at least `min_hf`.
function_v0.name: close

function_v0.doc: Deploys this contract's own receiver from `receiver_wasm`.
function_v0.name: __constructor

udt_struct_v0.doc: One transfer of the swapped-out token (the flashed debt asset) the swap may pull from the\nreceiver: `debt.transfer(receiver, to, amount)`. Nothing else is authorized.
udt_struct_v0.name: Pull

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The swap, as a plain contract call the receiver makes: `contract.function(args\xe2\x80\xa6)`, e.g. the
Soroswap aggregator's `swap_exact_in(receiver, debt, amount, collateral, min_out, routes, None)`.
Kept generic so the contract never depends on one DEX's interface or address: a new
aggregator, a router or another venue works without redeploying. It is safe because the
receiver only pre-authorizes `pulls` (at most the flashed amount, never more), measures what
it actually received by balance, reverts below `min_out`, and returns any unspent input.
udt_struct_v0.name: SwapCall
